Rooms made of warm wood and woven cane

The bedroom

A low wooden bed with a rattan headboard, a woven pendant lamp and a plank-style ceiling. The room has its own air conditioner, and a sliding door opens to the bathroom.

The bunk room

Built-in bunks with a curtain on every bed, so each guest gets some privacy. Steps are part of the frame, which makes the top bunks easy to reach for kids and adults.

The bathrooms

Smooth plaster walls, a rain shower and strips of white pebbles along the floor. One bathroom has a freestanding tub, and another has a double sink under bamboo lanterns.
